publicRouteInventory.purpose: Comparison index, not a fourth concept or story. Three actual index chooser controls are exercised by primary alternatives.

A, At the fixture: a generic bring-up fixture built from seven socket/contact modules; opens from joined fixture to a command-to-observation arrangement, then reconnects. Personal fixture authorship grounds the recommendation; geometry is illustrative, not actual hardware.

B, Power-state selector: seven radial selector modules open into a teaching schedule; distinguishes a state schedule from physical observation and projected endurance from the observed run. Explicit teaching metaphor, not a device Ada built.
C, Observation lead: seven cylindrical sleeves form a connected lead, then separate a claim from its evidence window and reconnect. Explicit metaphor, not wiring or a plotted current trace.
Source calls notFound; not an advertised concept and no synthetic alternative selected.
